elements:
Tasks:
1. Collect Information (userTask - sales/customer support action)
2. Address Concerns (userTask - sales/customer support action)
3. Guide Product Selection (userTask - sales representative action)
4. Provide Quote (userTask - sales representative action)
5. Get Customer Approval (userTask - customer decision)
6. Place Order (userTask - sales representative action)
7. Record Order (serviceTask - system action)
8. Send Confirmation (sendTask - outbound notification)

Gateways:
1. XOR Gateway (customer interested or not)

Events:
1. Start Event (manual initiation by customer inquiry)
2. End Event (normal completion after order confirmation)

Boundary Events:
None (no timeouts or errors specified)

Subprocesses:
None

Complexity: Simple
pseudocode:
startEvent("Customer Inquiry Process Start")
userTask("Sales staff or customer support collects information")
userTask("Address any concerns or questions")

if (customer is interested):
    userTask("Guide customer through product/service selection")
    userTask("Provide quote")
    userTask("Get customer approval")
    userTask("Place order")
    serviceTask("Record order in system")
    sendTask("Send order confirmation to customer")
else:
    userTask("End interaction with customer")

endEvent("Customer Inquiry Process End")
